entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A massive furnace-city of the goblins of Mirrodin, also called the Great Furnace, now the main gateway into Mirrodin's Core.

entities.name: Steel Mother
entities.description: A deity the goblins of the Oxidda Chain believe created the plane.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Guards the gateway into Mirrodin's Core.

entities.name: Red Lacuna
entities.description: Located within the belly of the Furnace.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where Kuldotha is located.

entities.name: goblins of Mirrodin
entities.description: Goblins who used Kuldotha for their religion.

entities.name: Phyrexianization
entities.description: The event after which Kuldotha became the gateway into the Core.

events.summary: After the Phyrexianization Kuldotha becomes the main gateway into Mirrodin's Core, guarded by Urabrask.
events.quote: Since the Phyrexianization , Kuldotha has become the main gateway into Mirrodin's Core , guarded by Urabrask .
